mapper.sql: DATE(COALESCE(p.start_date, p.created_at)) < AND DATE( COALESCE( p.end_date, p.expected_end_date, LAST_DAY() ) ) >=
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE( ROUND( COALESCE(personal_scores.total_score, 0) * (COALESCE(weight_config.personal_weight_rate, 50) / 100.0) + COALESCE(team_scores.total_score, 0) * (COALESCE(weight_config.team_weight_rate, 50) / 100.0) ) * 3, 0 ) AS compositeScore FROM (SELECT #{employeeId} AS employee_id) base LEFT JOIN performance_weight weight_config ON weight_config.org_id = #{orgId} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.employee_id, SUM( LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p.difficulty_score, 5), 1), 10) * CASE WHEN p.expected_end_date IS NULL THEN 1.0 WHEN DATEDIFF(p.expected_end_date, p.end_date) >= 2 THEN 1.2 WHEN p.end_date <= p.expected_end_date THEN 1.0 ELSE GREATEST(0.0, 1.0 - DATEDIFF(p.end_date, p.expected_end_date) * 0.1) END * CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.achievement_rate, 80) >= 100 THEN 1.2 WHEN COALESCE(p.achievement_rate, 80) >= 90 THEN 1.1 WHEN COALESCE(p.achievement_rate, 80) >= 80 THEN 1.0 WHEN COALESCE(p.achievement_rate, 80) >= 60 THEN 0.8 ELSE 0 END ) AS total_score FROM performance p WHERE p.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND p.work_item = 'PERSONAL' AND p.status = 'ENDED' AND p.end_date IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(p.end_date) = #{targetYear} GROUP BY p.employee_id ) personal_scores ON personal_scores.employee_id = base.employee_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.employee_id, SUM( LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p.difficulty_score, 5), 1), 10) * CASE WHEN p.expected_end_date IS NULL THEN 1.0 WHEN DATEDIFF(p.expected_end_date, p.end_date) >= 2 THEN 1.2 WHEN p.end_date <= p.expected_end_date THEN 1.0 ELSE GREATEST(0.0, 1.0 - DATEDIFF(p.end_date, p.expected_end_date) * 0.1) END * CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.achievement_rate, 80) >= 100 THEN 1.2 WHEN COALESCE(p.achievement_rate, 80) >= 90 THEN 1.1 WHEN COALESCE(p.achievement_rate, 80) >= 80 THEN 1.0 WHEN COALESCE(p.achievement_rate, 80) >= 60 THEN 0.8 ELSE 0 END ) AS total_score FROM performance p WHERE p.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND p.work_item = 'TEAM' AND p.status = 'ENDED' AND p.end_date IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(p.end_date) = #{targetYear} GROUP BY p.employee_id ) team_scores ON team_scores.employee_id = base.employee_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO performance_metric_summary( employee_id, performance_year, performance_month, personal_kpi_achievement_rate, team_kpi_achievement_rate, monthly_core_goal_progress_rate, score_change_rate, composite_score, calculated_at ) VALUES ( #{employeeId}, #{targetYear}, #{targetMonth}, #{personalKpiAchievementRate}, #{teamKpiAchievementRate}, #{monthlyCoreGoalProgressRate}, #{scoreChangeRate}, #{compositeScore}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE personal_kpi_achievement_rate = VALUES(personal_kpi_achievement_rate), team_kpi_achievement_rate = VALUES(team_kpi_achievement_rate), monthly_core_goal_progress_rate = VALUES(monthly_core_goal_progress_rate), score_change_rate = VALUES(score_change_rate), composite_score = VALUES(composite_score), calculated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT employee_id AS employeeId, performance_year AS metricYear, performance_month AS metricMonth, personal_kpi_achievement_rate AS personalKpiAchievementRate, team_kpi_achievement_rate AS teamKpiAchievementRate, monthly_core_goal_progress_rate AS monthlyCoreGoalProgressRate, score_change_rate AS scoreChangeRate, composite_score AS compositeScore, calculated_at AS calculatedAt FROM performance_metric_summary WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND performance_year = #{targetYear} AND performance_month = #{targetMonth}

SELECT employee_id AS employeeId, performance_year AS metricYear, performance_month AS metricMonth, personal_kpi_achievement_rate AS personalKpiAchievementRate, team_kpi_achievement_rate AS teamKpiAchievementRate, monthly_core_goal_progress_rate AS monthlyCoreGoalProgressRate, score_change_rate AS scoreChangeRate, composite_score AS compositeScore, calculated_at AS calculatedAt FROM performance_metric_summary WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY performance_year DESC, performance_month DESC LIMIT 1
